اعتصمتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمْتُمْ (iʕtaṣamtum) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمْتُمْ (uʕtuṣimtum) /uʕ.tu.sˤim.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
